title: Legislation related caps (ord → reg mapping)
description: Array of caps related to the subject cap. Saved at output/legis/{abbr}/{cap}/relatedcaps_{lang}.json. For abbr=ord this endpoint returns a single self-lookup entry; for abbr=reg it returns all subsidiary regulations. Empty array when the cap has no related caps.

title.description: Long title of the related cap.

num.description: Cap number as a string — may include alpha suffix (e.g. '622J'). Stored as string because HKLII's num_int query parameter rejects alpha suffixes with HTTP 500.

path.description: HKLII URL path for the related cap.
